description: TokenWise: replace the model's copy of recognized shell results with a smaller projection; after a compaction, add the catalog of tool results TokenWise kept recallable with the next tool result. At startup, say when the tokenwise command is missing, when recorded output is worth learning from, and when a learning run finished.

hooks.command: if command -v tokenwise >/dev/null 2>&1; then tokenwise hook grok; else echo '{"systemMessage":"TokenWise: the tokenwise command is not on PATH, so the plugin does nothing yet. Install it: https://github.com/HKUDS/TokenWise#install"}'; fi
